title: Cobbletopia
description: The modpack adds Sodium and Iris for performance and the ability to use shaders! As well it has the Cobblemon mod which is needed for the Cobbletopia server that is also included.
body:
**Cobbletopia -** _This modpack is Cobbletopia's official server modpack! It is made for players playing on Cobbletopia and newcomers who would like to join with a ready to go optimised experience._ 
_**The modpack is based on the mod Cobblemon version 1.7.3 mainly.**_

**_Features:_**

**Performance Mods**

• 💻 Sodium - Grants major performance boosts.

• 👁️ Iris - Adds support to Sodium for shaders.

**Quality of Life Mods**

• 🌐 Cherished Worlds - For marking your favourite worlds and servers.

• 🧭 Xaero's Minimap - Adds a friendly minimap to ease exploration.

• 🗺️ Xaero's World Map - Adds a world map for exploration.

**Major Mods**

• 🐛 Cobblemon - Adds the world of Pokémon into Minecraft.

**Shaders**

• 🎨 Complementary Reimagined Shaders - Adds shaders for the good looks.

**Resource Packs**

• 🦋 E19 Cobblemon Minimap Icons - Adds Pokémon icons for the Xaero's Minimap.

_Also includes the IP for the Cobbletopia server!_

This modpack also supports singleplayer and other multiplayer experiences that only rely on the Cobblemon mod as their main dependency.

**What is Cobbletopia?**

Cobbletopia is a vanilla-friendly Minecraft Cobblemon server and experience willing to grow alongside its playerbase, hoping to create a great learning experience and good times. It only requires Cobblemon as its dependancy. The server features a daycare, shops, GTS, hunts and much more!

**Server IP:** cobbletopia.mc.gg

**Join our Discord for more info:** https://discord.gg/aS79d3NqVg 

_There is currently no known issues with the modpack._
